title: 遗忘的边界：有限容量下的记忆、智能与自我 / The Boundary of Forgetting: Memory, Intelligence, and the Self under Finite Capacity
description:
中文. 本著作提出“容量级联”框架，用以解释有限容量如何同时塑造记忆、智能与自我。

核心主张：大模型的键值缓存、智能体的上下文窗口与人的记忆并非同构，而是同约束——受同一组信息论限制（压缩、干扰、遗忘），却运行在相差约九个数量级的时间尺度上。遗忘因此不是失败，而是学习得以发生的前提。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—K、31 幅图；给出信息瓶颈、率失真、有效容量、表示坍塌与时间尺度分离的形式化；三个载体的失败（位置偏差、上下文漂移、忒修斯现象）被放在同一张表上比较。

诚实的纪律：同约束给出可检验的三条（C1 容量饱和、C2 双时间常数、C3 受限可塑性），任一条测不出即不在主张范围内；双分级与可证伪登记簿随书公开。

边界：同约束不等于同构，跨载体的机制差异不可抹平；“梦=正则化”等主张标为最低等级假说，并写明如何检验。

版本：2026-10-18，205 页，25 章，31 图，附录 A—K；含可复算脚本，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

本版更新（2026-10-18 地基版）。本版把全书的共同前提写到卷首：现实中不存在无限——无限只作为极限出现在模型里，从不出现在现实系统的实际状态里。有限性本身只说明“有上界”；它要变成“必须让出一样”，还需要三个条件同时成立：需求随规模增长、描述/组合/传递共享同一承载者、同时维持两种活动更贵（交互惩罚 ψ>0）。因此“至多取二”一律是“紧预算（K/D 有界）下至多取二”的简写；若预算增长快于需求，三项可以同时满格。

本版新增内容。第 7 章新增“有限性诊断”：上下文窗口、KV 缓存与突触资源共享 K_desc；三个载体同约束而非同构。卷首总纲明确：书中的“无限容量/无限上下文”是反事实对照，不是路线图。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/capacity-cascade。首选预览文件：capacity-cascade-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents a “capacity cascade” framework explaining how finite capacity shapes memory, intelligence and the self at once. Core thesis: the KV cache of a model, the context window of an agent and human memory are not isomorphic but iso-constrained — bound by one set of information-theoretic limits (compression, interference, forgetting) across roughly nine orders of magnitude in timescale. Forgetting is therefore the condition of learning, not its failure. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–K, 31 figures; formal treatments of the information bottleneck, rate–distortion, effective capacity, representational collapse and timescale separation; three characteristic failures (position bias, context drift, the Theseus phenomenon) compared in one table. Discipline: iso-constraint is operationalised as three testable conditions — capacity saturation, two time constants, constrained plasticity — and the framework is out of scope if any fails. Boundaries: iso-constraint is not isomorphism; the “dream as regularisation” claim is graded as a hypothesis with a stated test. Edition: 2026-10-18, 205 pages, 25 chapters, 31 figures, appendices A–K.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-18, Finitude Edition). The common premise is now stated at the front: there is no infinity in reality — infinity appears only as a limit in models, never as a property of a real system. Finitude alone only says that there is a ceiling; to yield a trade-off it also needs three conditions: demand grows with scale, description/composition/transfer share one bearer, and maintaining two activities at once is more expensive (interaction penalty ψ>0). “At most two” is therefore shorthand for “at most two under a tight budget (bounded K/D)”; if the budget grows faster than demand, all three can be full.

New in this edition. Chapter 7 adds a finitude diagnosis: context window, KV cache and synaptic resources share K_desc; the three carriers are iso-constrained, not isomorphic. The front matter states that “infinite capacity / infinite context” is a counterfactual contrast, not a roadmap.
notes: 科目（中文）：信息论 Information Theory、认知科学 Cognitive Science、机器学习 Machine Learning、神经科学 Neuroscience、复杂系统 Complex Systems、人工智能 Artificial Intelligence。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 201 页。首选预览文件：capacity-cascade-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
